verdict.rationale: Luma's own current API FAQ states plainly that there is no staging or sandbox environment. It recommends a test key and small generations instead, but that is a user-side workaround: test keys are production keys that share quota and are billed pay-as-you-go. The legacy 'Try It!' panel also sends requests to the production API endpoint, so it offers no isolation either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
